billingMethod.title: Billing method
billingMethod.paygBody: Billed hourly to your saved card. No wallet minimum, and it never pauses for balance.
billingMethod.prepaidBody: Billed from your prepaid wallet balance. Requires enough runway to keep running.
billingMethod.switchedNotResumed: Switched to {{method}}, but could not resume: {{reason}}

history.title: Billing history
history.none: No charges yet — billing begins once the deployment is running.
history.billedUpTo: Billed up to {{clock}}. Anything since then is still charged, on the next billing run.

alerts.pausedNoCreditBody: This deployment was stopped at the moment your balance ran out, so you were not charged for anything after that. Top up and it will resume automatically.
alerts.pausedDebtLimitBody: This deployment was paused because your outstanding balance went over the platform's limit. Nothing already billed is affected — it will resume automatically once your balance is back within the limit.
alerts.pausedCardRequiredBody: This platform now requires a verified card on file before any deployment can run, prepaid or pay-as-you-go. Add a card and this will resume automatically.
alerts.willPauseWithinHour: This deployment will pause within the hour
alerts.pausedAutomaticallyAt: Deployments are paused automatically when it reaches
alerts.outstandingIfChargeFails: outstanding balance if the charge fails.
alerts.underReview: Our team is reviewing your request
alerts.beingSetUp: Your instance is being set up
alerts.emailWhenLive: You'll get an email as soon as the endpoint is live. Billing starts only when it starts running.
alerts.pausedNoCreditDisk: Your {{storageGb}} GB disk is still reserved and bills at {{rate}}/hr until you terminate.
alerts.lowBalanceBody: Your balance is {{balance}} and everything you have running costs {{burnRate}}/hr. Deployments are paused automatically when it reaches {{stopAt}}.
alerts.paygNeverPauses: Your balance is {{balance}}, but this deployment won't pause — pay-as-you-go usage is billed to your saved card, or added to your outstanding balance if the charge fails.
alerts.storageGraceDaysLeft_one: {{count}} day left before this deployment is terminated and its storage released
alerts.storageGraceDaysLeft_other: {{count}} days left before this deployment is terminated and its storage released
alerts.askBilling: Ask an owner or a billing member of the account to sort this out.
